generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
All terms and Conditions as per tender Documents

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidder should have valid Class-3 and above Registered Electrical Contractor License issued from Public Work Department / Inspectorate of Electricity
The bidder should submit the GST/PAN Registration Certificate

Tenderer in their name should submit annual turnover certificate any two years from last five years ie, 2018-19 to 2022-23 of Rs.1.35 Lakhs in each year. The turn over certificate should be mandatorily certified from charted accountant and mention UDIN number is compulsory, otherwise it will be subjected to rejection

Tenderer should have at least executed and satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one Similar Electrical work such as Shifting of electrical line and the transformer in any Govt. Agency/ULBs/PSU for amount not less than Rs.0.68 Lakhs in Last 5 Years ie, 2018-19 2019-20 2020-21 2021-22 & 2022-23, NOTE- The work done certificate submitted should be signed not less than rank of Executive Engineer/Equivalents grade officer and also mention the E-procurement indent number
All other documents as per the tender bid documents
